sedonadb 0.4.1.9000
  • Reference

    Create a DataFrame from one or more Parquet files

    sd_read_parquet.Rd

    The query will only be executed when requested.

    sd_read_parquet(
  path,
  options = NULL,
  geometry_columns = NULL,
  validate = FALSE,
  partitioning = NULL
)

sd_ctx_read_parquet(
  ctx,
  path,
  options = NULL,
  geometry_columns = NULL,
  validate = FALSE,
  partitioning = NULL
)

    Arguments

    path

    One or more paths or URIs to Parquet files

    options

    A named list of options to pass to the Parquet reader.

    geometry_columns

    A JSON string or named list mapping column names to GeoParquet column metadata. This can be used to mark binary WKB columns as geometry columns or override existing GeoParquet metadata. The suggested jsonlite package is required when passing a list.

    validate

    Whether to validate geometry column contents against their metadata. Currently, this validates WKB input.

    partitioning

    A character vector of column names for hive-style partitioning. By default (NULL), partition columns are auto-discovered. Use character() to disable partitioning.

    ctx

    A SedonaDB context.

    Value

    A sedonadb_dataframe

    Examples

    path <- system.file("files/natural-earth_cities_geo.parquet", package = "sedonadb")
sd_read_parquet(path) |> head(5) |> sd_preview()
